descriptor.retrieval_description: Flexible packaged snack pouch with a smooth, dry polymer film wrapper. The intended contact region has flexible planar lateral surfaces with sealed edge ridges and some loose internal contents.
descriptor.contact_region: Lateral opposing side surfaces of the flexible pouch within the centered grasp band
descriptor.visible_surface_material: Polymer wrapper film with printed graphics
descriptor.visible_surface_condition: Clean and dry with minor wrinkles
descriptor.local_geometry: Slightly flattened planar-to-gently-curved surfaces with edge seals and flexible internal shifting contents
descriptor.uncertainty: The exact tactile compliance depends on the internal air volume and loose contents of the pouch, which are partially obscured by the packaging.
